what: Report from your words: POST /api/community/parse with one sentence; the reply is compared with the expected fill.
pass_mark: At most 5 wrong fills in 100 filled fields. 0 fields filled where the sentence says nothing. 0 wrong species on a snake sentence. 0 invalid values. Run 3 times on the same day; the lowest run is recorded.
labelling: expect: the value each field should get. A field not listed means the sentence says nothing for it.
ok: other values that are also accepted because the sentence is open to them. They are not counted wrong.
kind turned-up is expected for a visit with nothing that worked and no invasive framing; leaving kind blank is never wrong.
when YESTERDAY is resolved on the day of the run: this-week, or last-week if the run is on a Monday (Malaysia time).
snake: true means the reply must be the snake answer with no field filled.
